empty_opponent_action_space.game: Player 0 actions 0 and 1; player 1 no actions
empty_opponent_action_space.interpretation: Vacuity; Nonempty profile hypothesis correctly excludes this from bridge theorem

strict_order_dominance_with_some_ties.interpretation: Strict-order dominance and strict dominance intentionally differ

tied_duplicate_actions.game: One player, actions 0 and 1, payoff 0 at both
tied_duplicate_actions.interpretation: Distinct payoff-equivalent actions are weakly optimal but not strict

checked_equivalences: Strong Nash: changing-player witness versus nonempty profitable coalition
Strict Nash: different action versus different unilateral profile
Dominant: top of payoff preorder versus pointwise best action
Strict-order dominant: strict preorder versus weak everywhere and strict somewhere

scope_limit: Finite evidence only; no inference of a general theorem from enumeration
